job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Fixture Labs builds planning software for small teams. This fictional role works with engineering and design to improve the product and understand how customers use it.

Responsibilities

Interview users, investigate onboarding problems, write clear product specifications, prioritize improvements and measure the results of releases. Collaborate with the delivery team and explain decisions through concise written proposals.

Requirements

Experience owning software product decisions, working with analytics and testing prototypes with users. Communicate clearly, handle competing priorities and develop practical experiments. The role is remote and works with a distributed team. Applications and candidate decisions remain subject to the employer's current instructions.
